name: ayahquest
description: AyahQuest — A Duolingo-style Quran learning app for children and teens. Built on the Quran Foundation Content APIs with DeepSpeech-Quran AI recitation verification.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=client && npm install --workspace=server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n AI,SERVER,CLIENT -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
